_meta.title: DESNZ LCOE Calculation Specification
_meta.source: Annex B - Example LCOE Calculator 2025 (Onshore Wind LCOE sheet), DESNZ Electricity Generation Costs 2025
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable specification for implementing the exact LCOE calculation logic. Pair with annex_a_technical_assumptions.json for input parameters and annex_a_lcoe_results.json for validation targets.
_meta.note: All spreadsheet cell references are from the Onshore Wind LCOE sheet in Annex B and are provided for traceability only; they are not required for re-implementation.

hurdle_rate.source: Annex A: Hurdle Rate (Low/Medium/High) - use Medium unless otherwise specified

gross_load_factor.note: First value applies to year 1 of operation; can vary by year if a trajectory is given, otherwise constant
gross_load_factor.source: Annex A: Average load factor (net load factor)

availability.note: Defaults to 1.0 (100%) unless a separate availability trajectory is specified; net load factor in Annex A already nets out availability for most renewables

pre_development_phasing_pct.unit: fraction per year, sums to 1.0 over the pre-development period
pre_development_phasing_pct.source: Annex A: Pre-development phasing (Year 1, Year 2, ... Year 6+)

pre_licensing_cost_gbp_per_kw.source: Annex A: Pre-development Cost (Low/Medium/High) - treated as combining pre-licensing + regulatory in the calculator; can be split if source data allows

regulatory_licensing_cost_gbp_per_kw.note: In the example calculator this was 0 for onshore wind; check Annex A source notes per technology

construction_phasing_pct.unit: fraction per year, sums to 1.0 over the construction period

infrastructure_cost_gbp_thousand.note: N/A for offshore wind per Annex A general note 5 - offshore wind connection costs are excluded from capex and not captured elsewhere in this dataset

connection_uos_gbp_per_mw.source: Annex A: Connection and use of system charges

fuel_price_gbp_per_mwh.source: Not in this Annex A table for renewables; relevant for gas/hydrogen technologies

heat_revenue_price_gbp_per_mwh.note: Negative value; CHP technologies only, not applicable to wind/solar/CCGT-without-CHP
heat_revenue_price_gbp_per_mwh.source: Not present in this dataset for renewables

decommissioning_cost_gbp_thousand.note: Present in Annex A (Low/Medium/High) but excluded from the D16 master total in the example calculator; shown separately in Annex A results tables as 'Decommissioning and waste'

calculation_steps.name: discount_factor
calculation_steps.formula: discount_factor[1] = 1; discount_factor[t] = discount_factor[t-1] / (1 + hurdle_rate)  for t = 2..N
outputs: discount_factor[t] for each year t across the full project timeline (pre-development + construction + operation)

calculation_steps.name: generation
calculation_steps.applies_to_years: operation years only (pre-development and construction years have zero generation)

calculation_steps.name: pre_development_cost
calculation_steps.formula_annual: pre_dev_cost[t] = total_pre_dev_spend_gbp_m * pre_development_phasing_pct[t]   for t within the pre-development period

calculation_steps.name: construction_cost
calculation_steps.note_offshore_wind: For offshore wind, infrastructure_cost is typically N/A/excluded per Annex A note 5 - do not add a null/N/A value; treat as 0 or omit per source technology's documented treatment
calculation_steps.formula_annual: construction_cost[t] = (total_capital_spend_gbp_m + infrastructure_spend_gbp_m) * construction_phasing_pct[t]   for t within the construction period

calculation_steps.name: fixed_om_cost
calculation_steps.formula_annual: fixed_om[t] = fixed_om_gbp_per_mw * net_power_output_mw * 1e-6; insurance[t] = insurance_gbp_per_mw * net_power_output_mw * 1e-6; connection_uos[t] = connection_uos_gbp_per_mw * net_power_output_mw * 1e-6; total_fixed_om[t] = fixed_om[t] + insurance[t] + connection_uos[t]

calculation_steps.name: fuel_cost
calculation_steps.formula: fuel_consumption[t] = generation[t] / net_fuel_efficiency; fuel_cost[t] = fuel_price_gbp_per_mwh * fuel_consumption[t] * 1e-6
calculation_steps.note: Set to 0 for wind/solar (net_fuel_efficiency = 0, no fuel consumed); guard against division by zero in implementation

calculation_steps.name: heat_revenue
calculation_steps.note: Only applicable to CHP technologies; not applicable to wind, solar, or non-CHP gas plants. heat_revenue_price is negative, so this term reduces total LCOE when present. Lasts for 20 years (assumed heat offtaker contract length), not full operating lifetime.

calculation_steps.name: total_lcoe
calculation_steps.formula: lcoe_gbp_per_mwh = pre_dev_cost_per_mwh + construction_cost_per_mwh + fixed_om_per_mwh + variable_om_per_mwh + fuel_cost_per_mwh + heat_revenue_per_mwh
calculation_steps.note_ccus: For CCUS technologies, add: carbon_cost_per_mwh + co2_transport_storage_cost_per_mwh (same discounted-cost-over-discounted-generation pattern; not detailed here as wind/solar have neither)
calculation_steps.note_decommissioning: Decommissioning cost is present in Annex A input data and in Annex A results tables as a separate line item ('Decommissioning and waste'), but is NOT included in the D16 master total formula in the example Annex B calculator. Confirm treatment against the specific technology's Annex A results row before deciding whether to include it in a downstream model.

validation_targets.description: Use annex_a_lcoe_results.json as the source of truth to validate a re-implementation. Match on [technology][commissioning_year]['Total13'] (or equivalent 'Total' key) against your computed lcoe_gbp_per_mwh.

companion_files.annex_a_technical_assumptions.json: Raw input parameters for all 30 technologies x 5 commissioning years (2030/2035/2040/2045/2050), keyed by technology name then year.
companion_files.annex_a_lcoe_results.json: Official DESNZ-computed LCOE results (£/MWh, broken down by cost category) for all technologies x years, for validation.
